items.title: test(proxies): pin clef mtime cache and design-code keep-alive/error contracts (#782)
items.body: Tests only — no behaviour changes to either proxy. Closes the regression-net gap filed as #782 for PR #768. ## What is pinned **clef-proxy mtime credential cache** (`bin/clef-proxy.test.mjs`, new `clef-proxy config cache contract (#782)` suite; stub gateway via the #692 `CLEF_PROXY_GATEWAY_BASE` seam observes the exact token each request presents; mtimes controlled with `fs.utimesSync`, temp `HOME`): - first request reads the token from the config file; - changed contents with an **unchanged mtime are not re-read** (the cached value is served — this is the cache contract, including its known sharp edge); - changed contents with a **new mtime are re-read** (rotated token served on the next request); - a missing token file yields the fallback (401, gateway never called). **design-code-proxy keep-alive pools + response error handling** (`bin/design-code-proxy.test.mjs`; the stub now also records the source port of each backend connection and gains an `error-mid-stream` mode — head + partial body, then the socket is destroyed): - sequential requests **reuse the keep-alive pool** (both calls arrive from the same source port); - a backend response error **before headers** (non-stream: no head sent until the body completes) **falls back** to the second backend; - a backend response error **after headers** (streaming) **tears the client response down promptly** — the test asserts the body read rejects well before the client's own 5s abort, so a hanging proxy cannot pass it. ## Verification - `node --test bin/clef-proxy.test.mjs bin/design-code-proxy.test.mjs` — **25/25 pass** on the laptop (18 pre-existing + the new contracts). - **Ablation** (temp copies, proxies reverted to pre-#768 behaviour: cache lookup removed; `agent: false` + backend response error handlers removed): exactly the four new contract tests fail — unchanged-mtime cache, pool reuse, before-headers fallback (hangs to the client abort), after-headers teardown (rejects only at the client abort, failing the promptness bound). The remaining new assertions pin behaviour both versions share. Queue task 1252. Refs #782 — this PR satisfies its acceptance criteria; the issue closes when it merges. --- Need help on this PR? items.title: id: production currency gateway service with durable write-ahead intents (#5522)
items.body: ## What this lands The missing bounded slice of #5522: the production currency gateway *service* — #10070 item 1's remainder (design #2043 phase 3). The F3 envelope (#2319), F1 registry, and F2 factory were landed pieces; the F5 composition (#2321) was a proof of concept whose own write-up named what production still owed. This PR builds exactly that, as a new module `pkgs/id/src/currency/gateway_service.rs`: - **Durable idempotency (PoC item 13).** An `IntentStore` keyed by the §4.3 idempotency ID itself — `FileIntentStore` (one JSON per intent, atomic tmp+fsync+rename writes, persisted key bindings, append-only findings log) plus an in-memory implementation for tests. A retry, in-process or after a restart, is answered from the record. - **Write-ahead execution (invariant 6).** Issue/transfer persist a `Recorded` intent carrying the exact pre-generated transfer (ID = idempotency ID) *before* submission. Crash recovery resolves by ledger lookup: present-and-identical finalizes as posted, absent resubmits the stored transfer under the same ID, present-but-different is a surfaced `IntentConflict`, never an overwrite. A cluster refusal is likewise durable: the retry replays the stored verdict. - **Restart-safe state (PoC item 5).** `GatewayService::open` rebuilds from the intent log: registry records (register intents now carry their registration parameters; rebuild is ledger-order deterministic and fails closed on divergence), currency key bindings, issued supply (posted issues re-sum — the cap view survives restart), and the minter set. - **Two-way reconciliation (invariant 7).** `reconcile_intents` joins intents ↔ ledger in both directions (posted-but-missing, posted-but-different, failed-but-present, unresolved, and ledger transfers with no intent), appends every finding to the durable findings log before returning, and repairs nothing. The F4 audit stays exposed unchanged as `audit()`. Small visibility edits in `gateway_poc.rs` share the PoC-proven pieces (`RegistryView`, `BackendCluster`, `check_event`, `mint_currency_id`, receipt signing) instead of duplicating them — receipts verify identically whichever composition issued them. ## Scope, stated plainly - Executes `register_currency`, `grant_minter`, `issue`, `transfer` — the op set the PoC proved. - `freeze`/`sunset` refuse by name (`Unsupported`): the registry crate has no status-transition write. Follow-up filed: #13342. - `convert` is phase 5, gated on #3801/#3802 and the anchored-ledger work (#10070 items 2–3) — untouched here. - Abuse controls (§4.3 step 6) and graph chain-continuity validation remain absent, at PoC parity (its write-up items 10–11). ## Tests Seven new tests in the module: full flow + durable replay, restart rebuild (registry/supply/minters, incl. cap and minter proofs after restart), both crash-window halves, durable failed verdicts, each reconciliation drift kind + findings-log persistence, authorization refusals leaving no intent, and unsupported-op refusals. Remote dispatch (fleet-command, developing-today/fleet run 45188841461): `cargo test -p id --lib currency::` in the pkgs/id nix dev shell — result recorded on #5522 when the run lands. ## Dependencies None added. Refs #5522, #10070 (item 1). Does not close #5522 — it is the tracking shell; item 1's named remainder is what lands here. --- Open in [code]smith · Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need. ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * Added a currency gateway that supports currency registration, minter access, issuance, and transfers. * Requests can be safely retried: completed operations replay their original result, while interrupted issuance and transfers can resume after restart. * Added consistency checks that identify discrepancies between recorded operations and ledger transfers and make findings available for review.

items.title: feat(aggregator): bulk triage mode for Needs-you — multi-select batch actions (#1277)
items.body: Implements #1277 (queue task 4997): bulk triage mode for the aggregator Needs-you queues. **What changed** - `/attention` queue cards (Needs User + Needs Orchestrator, tier and session cards) carry a "Select for bulk triage" pick when the action surface is up. A card whose own controls are disabled (stale tier source) gets a disabled pick, so it can't be submitted against an unconfirmed item. - A bulk bar on the queues section: author picker, verb (acknowledge / snooze / escalate / delegate — the existing triage verbs only), the verb's payload controls, an optional reason, select-all, a live selected count, and a **review step listing every selected item + the chosen action before anything is submitted**. - New `POST /api/actions/batch`: each item is validated with the existing `validateNewAction` rules (plus the #1291/#1293 published-item checks for triage, section fetched once) and appended as **its own attributed audit entry** — never one opaque batch record — so the batch is recoverable from the entries. Response carries per-item results: failures are reported by ref with their error and append nothing, so failed items remain in Needs-you and a partial batch never silently drops work. Client tokens dedupe per item on repost, exactly like the single-action path. - The single-action path and its semantics are unchanged. **Tests** - Route tests: mixed success/failure batch (valid items recorded individually with distinct ids, invalid snooze/verb reported by ref with errors, failed refs absent from the store), per-item dedupe on repost, malformed envelopes → 400. - Render tests: picks + bulk bar render with identities, absent without. - `bun test test/actions.test.ts` — 19/19 pass. Full aggregator suite: 911 pass; the slice3 failure (`dns + sessions + pages routes serve`) and the `web-push`/`@types/bun` resolution errors are pre-existing on clean main in this worktree (no `node_modules` installed there) — verified by running slice3 with these changes stashed. --- Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need. ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * Added bulk triage to the Needs User and Needs Orchestrator queues. Select eligible cards and acknowledge, snooze, escalate, or delegate them together, with an optional reason. * Review selected actions before submitting. If results are uncertain, retry without changing the reviewed actions; successful actions are cleared, while unsuccessful ones remain selected. Successful batches refresh the page. * Cards with stale sources cannot be selected for bulk actions.
